title: スワンSの後に・切り開かれた可能性！

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory was something else! And the way she accelerated right at the end was unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I think we just witnessed the birth of a real promising sprinter! Do you think she'll run miles too?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Yes! I did it! Heck yeah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I did it… I've found my weapon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I meet up with Bamboo Memory after her impressive performance…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah! Hey, Traineeeeer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I feel like everything's finally come together!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I've found my weapon! I figured out what I'm good at! I can do it! I can become a super strong, hardcore racer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that she's seen for herself what she's capable of, her eyes take on the burning gleam of a new, hopeful light!
choice_data_list: Let's turn up the heat for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Does that mean…
choice_data_list: Yep! We're running G1 miles and sprints senior year!
Yep! We're running G1 miles and sprints senior year!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ohhh…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: OOOHHH! We're running miles and sprints?!
choice_data_list: Let's make you the best at both!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after the Swan Stakes…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So?! Have you decided yet?! What G1 are we taking on first? Tell me, tell me, tell me!
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race that decides the spring champion of the sprint will make the perfect stage to show off Bamboo Memory's skills!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Roger that! Wow, I'm gonna be joining the battle to become the spring sprint champion…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gwaaah! Why can't it just be spring already? There's no way I can wait!
choice_data_list: Then take that energy and put it into training!
Then take that energy and put it into training!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're right!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Then let's train till I drop every day until spring!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You'd better not go easy on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our journey to the top has begun! Next stop, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen in spring!
